content: MaxMind GeoLite2-ASN is free (account + license key required, GeoLite2 EULA with attribution requirement) and maps IP -> ASN + AS-organization-name only -- it does not itself flag VPN/hosting/proxy status. For true is_hosting_provider / is_anonymous_vpn / is_public_proxy / is_tor_exit_node flags, MaxMind sells the commercial GeoIP2 Anonymous IP database (paid subscription, downloadable .mmdb, same offline reader as GeoLite2-City).
